children.text: I built an AI agent at my Fortune 500 company. It earned the trust of thousands of users because it's friendly and engaging. I learned many lessons along the way and want to share them with you  all. The key is: do what you think is right, keep your critical thinking sharp, pull yourself together and build what you believe.
